items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: I ran back and heard the Laysen Band play just sort of the last half of their last number.

ctx.x: And I didn't really get to hear them play because I walked all the way with the Tuxedo group. And when we got up to the end and they were through playing and turned off of Canal Street, I ran back and heard the Laysen Band play just sort of the last half of their last number. And that was about it.
We can restrict this, but what did you think of that? Well, it's still a continuous existence, but of that, you call it revived, I'd call it revised.
